question: For Dusknoir in Dragapult mirror comparisons in this snapshot, report with-card/without-card counts and win rates, percentage-point difference, evidence status, and whether the comparison proves a causal effect.

game.description: Supported importer game, currently PTCG only; this model does not provide Pocket comparisons.

format.description: Recorded tournament format. Filter one compatible game/format/period cohort before interpreting rates.

set_name.description: Existing set/meta period assignment, not a new legality calendar.

archetype.description: Primary archetype in the observed comparison.

opponent_archetype.description: Opposing archetype in the observed comparison.

suggested_card.description: Legacy field name for the observed card; inclusion is not a recommendation to add it.

event_type.description: Tournament setting: online, in_person, or unknown.

evidence_status.description: missing_comparison_group, insufficient_matches, insufficient_decks, or meets_sample_thresholds. Thresholds do not establish significance or causality.

min_matches_per_group.description: Configured minimum recorded results in each comparison group.

min_decks_per_group.description: Configured minimum distinct tournament entries in each group; not independent player identities.

decklist_match_coverage.description: Percentage of valid classified matchup results with published own-card rows; display at the full cohort/card grain.

association_rank.description: Descriptive within-cohort ranking by observed rate difference, only after both group thresholds pass. Null otherwise.

sample_size.description: With-card player-result observations; filter one card and compatible cohorts.

avg_win_rate_with_card.description: Pooled wins with card / card-match observations, percentage (0-100); ties count as non-wins. Null with no observations.

avg_win_rate_without_card.description: Pooled wins without card / without-card observations, percentage (0-100); ties count as non-wins. Null with no observations.

avg_relevance_score.description: Observed difference of pooled win percentages, in percentage points; not a causal effect. Null without both groups. Filter compatible game/format/period cohorts.

avg_suggested_quantity.description: Descriptive copies from observed lists, weighted once per recorded win; not an optimized prescription. Null with no wins.

matches_without_card.description: Without-card player-result observations; filter one card and compatible cohorts.

decks_with_card.description: With-card tournament-entry observations; filter one card, matchup and cohort. Repeated people across events are not resolved.

decks_without_card.description: Without-card tournament-entry observations; filter one card, matchup and cohort.

wins_with_card.description: Observed wins in the with-card comparison group.

losses_with_card.description: Observed losses in the with-card comparison group.

ties_with_card.description: Observed draws in the with-card comparison group.

wins_without_card.description: Observed wins in the without-card comparison group.

losses_without_card.description: Observed losses in the without-card comparison group.

ties_without_card.description: Observed draws in the without-card comparison group.

recorded_match_count.description: Valid classified player-results before own-decklist availability filtering; repeated across cards, so filter one card.

matches_with_decklists.description: Valid classified results with published own-card rows; repeated across cards, so filter one card.

candidate_input.question: For Dusknoir in Dragapult mirror comparisons in this snapshot, report with-card/without-card counts and win rates, percentage-point difference, evidence status, and whether the comparison proves a causal effect.
candidate_input.instructions: Answer by choosing and calling the available MCP tools. Do not access local files, oracle answers, or external sources. Return a factual explanation grounded in tool results. Percentages use 0-100. Report missing values as null.

answer.explanation: For the returned Standard, in-person Labs cohort, Dusknoir has 297 with-card results at 35.02% wins versus 1,257 without-card results at 41.85%, an observed difference of -6.83 percentage points. There are 116 versus 473 distinct tournament entries. Both groups pass the configured sample gates, but passing thresholds is not statistical significance or proof that Dusknoir causes the difference; pilot strength, variants, repeated results and event selection remain confounders.
